# pi and oh-my-pi (omp) engine providers

## What to build

Add two engine providers: `--provider pi` (bin `pi`, npm `@mariozechner/pi-coding-agent`) and `--provider omp` (bin `omp`, npm `@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent`, a fork of pi). Both print the same JSONL event format, so they share one line parser and one tool-call extractor. Each follows the existing adapter pattern documented at the top of `packages/graph-execution/src/providers/claude.ts`:
- an args builder with `--model` and `GRAPH_EXECUTION_<NAME>_ARGS`;
- the prompt sent on **stdin**, never on argv;
- a line parser that falls back to the raw line;
- a registry entry in `getProvider`.

The catalog (`src/providers/catalog.ts`, entries `pi` and `omp`) already exists with `engine: false`. Set both to `engine: true`; that makes `--provider pi|omp` valid, and `--review-provider` and reviewers files accept them too.

Facts below were verified against pi 0.73.1 and omp 18.18.8, run against a fake model server.

### pi
- Command: `pi --mode json --no-session [--model <m>] ...$GRAPH_EXECUTION_PI_ARGS`, prompt on stdin. A non-TTY stdin is read, trimmed and used as the prompt, and a pipe switches pi to print mode, so no `-p` and no argument are needed. pi never asks for tool approval.
- **pi exits 0 even when the model request fails in `--mode json`.** Watch each `message_end` whose `message.role === "assistant"`, and remember the last one's `stopReason`. If it is `"error"` or `"aborted"` (`message.errorMessage` holds the reason) and the process exited 0, the run's `done` must resolve to `{ exitCode: 1 }`, and the adapter must emit an output event `pi: <errorMessage>\n`. Because `done` comes from the exit code while lines are read in `events()`, build `done` as a promise that waits for both the exit code and the end of line reading, e.g. by reading the lines in a background async function started in `run()` that pushes into a queue consumed by `events()`. Every consumer must still see all output events, then the `exit` event with the corrected code.

### omp
- Command: `omp --mode json --no-session --auto-approve [--model <m>] ...$GRAPH_EXECUTION_OMP_ARGS`, prompt on stdin (it is read untrimmed, which is fine). **Always pass `--auto-approve`**: a user's `approvalMode` setting would otherwise deny tools in headless mode and still exit 0.
- **omp runs only on Bun** (`#!/usr/bin/env bun`; `node` cannot run it). `getProvider("omp")` checks `omp` **and** `bun` with `findOnPath`. Missing bun throws `Error('the "omp" CLI needs Bun: install it from https://bun.sh')`.
- omp exits 1 on `stopReason` error, even in json mode, but apply the same stopReason check as pi anyway.

### JSON events (shared)

```jsonl
{"type":"session","version":3,"id":"…","cwd":"/w"}
{"type":"message_update","assistantMessageEvent":{"type":"text_delta","contentIndex":0,"delta":"Let me look."}}
{"type":"message_end","message":{"role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Let me look."},{"type":"toolCall","id":"call_1","name":"bash","arguments":{"command":"echo hi"}}],"stopReason":"toolUse"}}
{"type":"tool_execution_start","toolCallId":"call_1","toolName":"bash","args":{"command":"echo hi"}}
{"type":"tool_execution_end","toolCallId":"call_1","toolName":"bash","result":{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"hi\n"}]},"isError":false}
{"type":"message_end","message":{"role":"toolResult", …}}
{"type":"message_end","message":{"role":"assistant","content":[],"stopReason":"error","errorMessage":"500 Internal Server Error"}}
```

- `parsePiLine(line)`:
  - For `message_end` with `role: "assistant"`, return the joined `text` items + `"\n"`. When there is no text, return `""`; the caller skips empty output.
  - For `message_update`, `tool_execution_*`, `session`, `turn_*`, `agent_*` and `message_start`, return `""`. They are noise: the deltas would duplicate the text, and the tool calls are reported through `tool` events.
  - Anything that is not JSON (stderr) is returned as is + `"\n"`.

  Unknown JSON event types are also dropped; returning the raw line instead is acceptable, but be consistent and test it.
- `piJsonToolCalls(line)` in `src/providers/tools.ts`: only `type === "tool_execution_start"` with a string `toolName` gives `[{ name: toolName, input: args ?? {} }]`. Everything else gives `[]`. omp adds fields such as `partialArgs`, `streamIndex` and `duration` on other events; they never appear in `args`.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `packages/graph-execution/src/providers/qwen.ts` (64 lines): the template. Copy its shape, including:
  ```ts
  const agent = spawnAgent(QWEN_BIN, qwenArgs(opts), { ...opts, input: opts.prompt });
  const done = agent.exitCode.then((exitCode) => ({ exitCode }));
  done.catch(() => {});
  async function* events() { try { for await (const line of agent.child.iterable({ from: "all" })) { … } } catch {} yield { type: "exit", code: (await done).exitCode }; }
  ```
- `packages/graph-execution/src/providers/claude.ts` L1-18: the documented pattern.
- `packages/graph-execution/src/providers/spawn.ts`:
  - `SpawnOptions` (L8-19)
  - `spawnAgent` (L111-176): the prompt is `input`; `exitCode` rejects when the process cannot start (`failed to start "<file>": …`).
- `packages/graph-execution/src/providers/tools.ts`: `json(line)` helper (L12-19) and `opencodeToolCalls` (L48-54), the pattern to mirror. Update the header comment (L1-9) with the pi/omp format.
- `packages/graph-execution/src/providers/index.ts` L57-80: add `case "pi"` and `case "omp"` like `case "qwen"`, calling `piArgs({})` / `ompArgs({})` so a malformed args env throws at startup.
- `packages/graph-execution/src/agents/loop.ts` L8-9 `DESCRIPTIVE_KEYS = new Set(["description"])`: no change is needed. Update the comment to say pi and omp tool args carry no descriptive keys.
- `packages/graph-execution/src/providers/qwen.test.ts` (172 lines): the test template. Mirror its fake CLI script (it records argv, cwd and stdin to `FAKE_<X>_RECORD`, prints JSONL, writes a stderr line, and exits with `FAKE_<X>_EXIT` or hangs). Also mirror its `beforeEach` / `afterEach` (mkdtemp binDir with `writeFakeBin` from `src/__fixtures__/fake-bin.ts`, PATH prepended, env restored) and its tests: unattended argv, `--model` plus extra args, quoted args, non-zero exit, abort kills the child, ENOENT, the parse unit tests, and getProvider found/not found.
- `packages/graph-execution/src/providers/tools.test.ts`: sample-line constants plus a `describe` per extractor.
- `packages/graph-execution/src/cli.test.ts` L365-470: CLI tests that run the codex, opencode and qwen adapters end to end with fake binaries on the PATH. Add one for pi in the same style.

## Step-by-step tasks

### CREATE `packages/graph-execution/src/providers/pi-json.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: `parsePiLine(line): string` and `piFailure(line): string | undefined`, which returns the `errorMessage` (or `"the model request failed"`) for an assistant `message_end` whose stopReason is error or aborted, and `undefined` for any other assistant `message_end`. Also export a small factory `runPiLike(bin, args, opts): AgentRun` used by both providers. It implements the corrected-exit-code logic described above.

### CREATE `packages/graph-execution/src/providers/pi.ts` and `omp.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - pi.ts: `PI_BIN = "pi"`, `PI_ARGS_ENV = "GRAPH_EXECUTION_PI_ARGS"`, `piArgs(opts, env)` → `["--mode","json","--no-session", ...(model ? ["--model", m] : []), ...extra]`, `piProvider`.
  - omp.ts: `OMP_BIN`, `OMP_ARGS_ENV`, `ompArgs` → `["--mode","json","--no-session","--auto-approve", …]`, `ompProvider`.
- Header comments in the style of `qwen.ts`.

### UPDATE `src/providers/tools.ts`, `src/providers/index.ts`, `src/providers/catalog.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - `piJsonToolCalls` in tools.ts.
  - The `pi` and `omp` cases in index.ts, plus the Bun check for omp.
  - `engine: true` for pi and omp in catalog.ts.

### CREATE tests
- `src/providers/pi.test.ts` and `src/providers/omp.test.ts`, mirroring qwen.test.ts. Extra cases:
  - pi: the fake prints an assistant `message_end` with `stopReason:"error", errorMessage:"boom"` and exits 0. Expect `done` to be `{exitCode: 1}`, an output event containing `boom`, and the last event to be `{type:"exit", code:1}`.
  - omp: argv contains `--auto-approve`. With a fake `omp` but no `bun` on the PATH (`PATH=[binDir]` plus the node dir only, without bun), `getProvider("omp")` rejects with `/needs Bun/`. With a fake `bun` also in binDir, it resolves.
- `src/providers/tools.test.ts`: `piJsonToolCalls` gives the call for `tool_execution_start`, and `[]` for `tool_execution_end`, `message_end` and non-JSON.
- `src/cli.test.ts`: a run of the diamond fixture with a fake `pi` on the PATH that creates the file the task asks for. Mirror the qwen CLI test, which shows how the fake CLI writes the task file and commits.

### UPDATE docs
- `packages/graph-execution/README.md`:
  - Add pi and omp to the provider lists (L5, L15, L86, L101), the `GRAPH_EXECUTION_*_ARGS` line (L47) and the "Supported agents" table.
  - Add to Safety (~L577): pi never asks (no flag); omp gets `--auto-approve`; omp needs Bun.
- Add `"pi"` and `"oh-my-pi"` to `keywords` in `packages/graph-execution/package.json`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `graph-execution --help` lists `claude|codex|opencode|qwen|pi|omp` (copilot may be there too if its task landed).
- [ ] `--provider pi` with no `pi` on the PATH exits 2: `the "pi" CLI was not found on the PATH; install it and log in before running`.
- [ ] `--provider omp` with omp but no bun exits 2 with `needs Bun`.
- [ ] The pi adapter sends the prompt on stdin, and its argv is exactly `--mode json --no-session` (+ `--model m`) (+ extra args).
- [ ] A pi model failure (stopReason error, exit 0) counts as a failed attempt (exit code 1).
- [ ] Loop detection sees pi/omp tool calls (tools.test.ts).
- [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test -w graph-execution` pass.

## Validation commands

```bash
npm run typecheck && npm run lint
npm test -w graph-execution -- src/providers src/cli.test.ts
```
